title: Prepared famat nf_cxlog
objective: Implement and qualify the smallest faithful PARI 2.17.4 prepared famat nf_cxlog cut for totally real cubics, with atomic Ga publication and all dynamic/native differential oracles

oracles: native GMP and tagged differential replay

handoff.summary: Added an ordinary CPython-parseable, source-transparent native translation of PARI 2.17.4 famat nf_cxlog for totally real cubics. The packed entry preserves primitive normalization, scalar parity dispatch, source-order accumulation, the 64-bit low-precision frontier, and atomic Ga-column publication. A pinned source oracle gives exact agreement across PARI, CPython, generated JavaScript, GMP, and tagged backends.
risks: This first cut intentionally supports only degree-three signature (3,0) and integral basis factors; mixed quartic complex-norm preflight and arbitrary rational basis columns remain outside its contract.
The receipt uses synthetic famats on the actual tuning cubic, not yet Ge multipliers captured from a completed genback/class_group_gen trace.
Windows uses the documented dynamic same-source fallback until this kernel enters a broader cross-platform native qualification matrix.

The full native correctness/lifecycle suite passed, but the final unrelated dense-ZZ performance gate measured multiply_150 at 31.76 ms normalized against a 30 ms budget while concurrent project builds were active; no second full build was started during coordinated resource contention.
next_steps: Connect the packed factors emitted by genback to this entry and replay actual Ge-to-Ga columns for the class-number-three tuning cubic.
Generalize the same source body to signature (2,1), adding PARI's low_prec(gnorm(z)) complex-place preflight and 2*i*pi scalar weighting.
Feed Ga into the existing exact log-matrix transform for act_arch(Ur,Ga), diagact_arch(cyc,Ga), GD, and ga.
